structuralSavings.scope: Bound-root D1 only. Both arms retain the prior preparation/execution HTTP request reductions.

localVerification.scope: Real local Workers, D1, Durable Objects, protocol execution, and persistence. No cryptographic primitive or SDK code changed.

review.scope: Reuse the verified Deriver A target within one fresh wallet-DO execution request.
findings: Fresh execution validates the request, admits the exact tenant root, and signs the readiness receipt before constructing its target.
The target is consumed by value. It is neither cloneable nor serializable and is not added to persisted pair state.
A persisted Prepared pair selects StoredAdmission and reloads its root with ReadAdmitted, including the existing metadata-digest check.
The wallet DO checks its relocation fence after awaited admission and before persisting preparation.
Production retirement reconciles a wallet-owned pair with its DO before recording admission cancellation. Direct D1 cancellation excludes wallet-owned pairs.
After B accepts, the local claim checks the cancellation fence before releasing A's target proof. Completion also checks the fence.
The existing proof helper consumes the verified root share. Its retained private partial uses Zeroizing. No new cryptographic arithmetic or secret-dependent branch was introduced.
Exact completed retries retain the stored response; changed input, peer receipt, root identity, or owner remains invalid.
review.tradeoff: Target-proof preparation now runs during admission before B connection. The previous root reread and target preparation overlapped B connection. One eliminated D1 round trip does not imply its full duration is removed from the critical path.
review.nextTransportCandidate: Combine B preparation and execution on one authenticated connection, keeping independent role keys, root checks, durable claim, cancellation, completion, and retry semantics. No such transport change is included in this candidate.
review.limitations: This focused review is not a comprehensive constant-time or cryptographic security audit.

independentSignatureVerification.verifier: Node.js crypto Ed25519 with independent NEP-413 Borsh encoding

limitations: Three samples per arm do not establish tail percentiles or a latency guarantee.
Sequential arms include provider scheduling and network variation.
Fresh wallets do not prove cold Workers. Worker cold starts were not controlled.
Invocation wall time can include background work and is not browser response time.
Nested spans overlap. Protocol spans include transport. Concurrent status durations must not be added.
Bound-root D1 counters cover a subset of database work. Total registration D1 calls remain unmeasured.
Fresh A executions consume their verified admission result once in the same request. Resumed persisted preparations reload their admitted root. Local cancellation and relocation fences still apply.
Requested APAC placement does not prove physical colocation.

decision.reason: A fresh execution consumes its already validated admission target once. It removes one bound-root D1 round trip and three statements without changing resumed execution or local fences.
decision.userDirection: Keep correct, simple optimizations that reduce work or network requests despite small-sample timing variation. Record structural savings separately from measured latency and compare cumulative changes later.
decision.tradeoff: Target-proof preparation now precedes B connection. Previously the repeated root read and preparation ran alongside that connection. The eliminated D1 duration is not a full-flow latency estimate.
decision.measuredConclusion: Full registration-to-signature medians are **12.159s → 10.650s → 10.720s**. The candidate's timing must be read alongside the restored control. This sample establishes fewer D1 calls; it does not isolate a repeatable latency gain from this change.
decision.uncertainty: The three arms ran sequentially with three fresh wallets each. Worker cold state, provider scheduling, and network conditions were not controlled. A faster or slower candidate is not established as a causal effect or as provider-only noise.
decision.nextStep: Evaluate combining B preparation and execution on one authenticated connection. Preserve independent role keys and root checks, exact wallet ownership, durable claims, cancellation, and retry semantics. Compare accumulated accepted optimizations against a frozen earlier baseline.
